message: Your POS system froze during peak hours yesterday and nobody from support responded for 12 days. I lost 3 hours of sales data. Very frustrated with QuickServe.
QuickServe's appointment booking module increased my salon bookings by 40%. The automated reminders reduced no-shows significantly. Excellent platform for service businesses.
Your billing module has been down for 3 days. My cafe cannot process digital payments. I lost walk-in customers. Refund my subscription immediately or I'm switching to PetPooja.
QuickServe doesn't have a class scheduling module for gyms. I'm managing my batch timings manually on paper. Can you add group class booking? Competitors already have this.
I was charged twice for the Premium plan this month — ₹5,500 x 2. Also the GST invoice download is broken since last update. Fix this or I'll raise a chargeback.
The parent communication module in QuickServe is exactly what our school needed. Fee reminders and attendance alerts saved us 5 hours per week. Thank you for the education vertical!
File uploads for project deliverables have been failing since yesterday on QuickServe. Error 500 every time. I cannot share client proofs on time. This is damaging my reputation.
3.5 years with QuickServe and the inventory tracking module alone saved us from wastage worth ₹4 lakhs. Batch expiry alerts for organic produce are a lifesaver. Highly recommended.
QuickServe's SMS notification system is completely broken. Booking confirmations are NOT reaching my travel customers. Lost 3 group tour bookings worth ₹2.5L this week. Fix this NOW.
QuickServe's analytics dashboard doesn't show season-wise sales trends for my boutique. I need to plan inventory for festivals but reports only show monthly totals. Competitors offer this.
22 days since I reported a critical API integration bug with QuickServe's REST API. My team cannot sync client data with our CRM. No response from engineering. Evaluating alternatives.
QuickServe's online ordering integration boosted our takeaway revenue by 60%. The QR menu with real-time updates is a game changer for our restaurant. Customers love it.
QuickServe pricing went from ₹999 trial to ₹7,500/month — that's 3x jump with no warning. For a small construction firm doing project billing, this is too expensive. Cancel immediately.
QuickServe's appointment module reduced pet grooming no-shows by 35%. Vaccination tracking and automated reminders are perfect for veterinary clinics. Pet parents love the reminder SMSes.
The 3D room visualization feature in QuickServe crashes on mobile browsers. My interior design clients want to preview layouts on their phones but it never renders properly. Only works on desktop.
Managing 200 coworking members with QuickServe is seamless. Automated billing, access control, and meeting room booking saves us 20 hours monthly. Best investment for our space.
QuickServe's GPS tracking integration showed wrong delivery locations 4 times this week. My logistics clients are complaining about misrouted packages. This module needs urgent fixing.
Patient records and appointment scheduling on QuickServe reduced our clinic wait times by 50%. Prescription history lookup is instant now. Staff absolutely loves the interface.
Nobody from QuickServe visited for the promised on-site setup. The crop monitoring alerts stopped working right during harvest season. Lost significant yield because of missed frost warnings.
QuickServe needs a video class recording feature for online coaching. Students want to replay sessions. Also the attendance report export to Excel is formatted incorrectly.
